description: Defines the Drupal node entity class, including its properties, methods, and entity type annotations.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a content node entity in Drupal, with properties and methods for managing node data, revisions, access, and metadata.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Prepares the node entity before saving, setting owner and revision user if not explicitly set.

methods.name: preSaveRevision
methods.description: Prepares revision data before saving, ensuring revision log consistency.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Performs actions after saving, such as updating search index and access grants.

methods.name: preDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup before deleting nodes, removing them from search index.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup after deleting nodes, removing access records.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the content type (bundle) of the node.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access permissions for a given operation.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Gets the creation timestamp of the node.

methods.name: setCreatedTime
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the node.

methods.name: isPromoted
methods.description: Checks if the node is promoted to the front page.

methods.name: isSticky
methods.description: Checks if the node is sticky at the top of lists.

methods.name: baseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the base fields for the node entity, including title, author, status, timestamps, promote, and sticky.
